name: more-options-for-youtube
description: Browser extension (Firefox, Zen, Chrome, Safari) that filters YouTube and sets player defaults

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files test docs dist package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md
scripts.dev: web-ext run --ignore-files test docs dist package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md --start-url https://www.youtube.com/
scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test docs dist package.json package-lock.json scripts README.md
